name: MKTG 4362
title: Marketing Planning and Strategy
description: This capstone course provides an advanced understanding of strategic market planning. Drawing on knowledge from MKTG 3101/BADM 3750, MKTG 3208, and MKTG 3260, students learn to identify, evaluate, and propose actionable solutions to complex marketing problems and develop comprehensive marketing strategies in novel and unstructured contexts.
requirement_description: MKTG 3101 or BADM 3750; MKTG 3208; MKTG 3260; open only to business majors with senior class standing.
